methods.name: Proper-versus-reflective tetrahedral Euler transport classifier
capabilities: enumerate the two S4-equivariant involutive overlap transports
classify proper versus improper permutation parity
verify determinant equals permutation sign on the three-dimensional tetrahedral representation
map the two transport phases to flat zero and endpoint torsion residuals
methods.exactness: finite permutation and integer-matrix arithmetic only; no floating point, angle, trigonometry, or numerical pi
boundaries: current P000 does not provide the native orthogonal overlap map
tetrahedral symmetry alone permits both phases
proper/reflection selection is conditional on determinant type
scalar half-period observables do not distinguish the phases
